 We are seeking a highly skilled Electrical Service person with experience in repairs and servicing to welding equipment or associated industrial machinery.   Applicants must have:  

 
	 Current recognised Australian Electrical workers Licence

	 "C" class manual drivers Licence 
	 Great communication skills 
 

 The successful applicant will join a team of highly skilled electrical service technicians working from our headquarters in Brisbane's bayside suburb of Lytton, just a short drive from the Gateway Bridge on the Port of Brisbane motorway. 

 As well as working from our Lytton premises the successful applicant will also become part of our mobile service team working from a service vehicle around the Brisbane Metropolitan area. 

 Working hours are 38 per week with 4 weeks holiday with leave loading per year, some overtime is available. Wages are well above the award and are negotiable. 

 On the job training plus a vast resource of machinery information are on hand as well as a great team of friendly, skilled service technicians to make the selected applicants smooth transition into a great work environment. So If you’re looking for a great opportunity to join a motivated and highly skilled team of service technicians with job satisfaction then contact us now!
